event: 2600 BCE - Mature phase of Indus Valley Civilisation
description: Advanced urban planning with sophisticated drainage systems in Harappa and Mohenjo-daro
Construction of the largest pyramid in Egypt. It is one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
Athletic competition establishing Greek cultural unity and international sporting tradition
Born as Prince Siddhartha in Lumbini, he founded Buddhism after achieving enlightenment.

event: 220 BCE - Construction of Great Wall of China begins
description: Qin Shi Huang connects existing walls to create massive defensive barrier
Trade routes connecting East and West facilitate cultural and economic exchange
Mauryan emperor Ashoka embraces non-violence and spreads Buddhism after Kalinga war

Macedonian king conquers parts of northwest India before turning back

event: 7000 BCE - Early agricultural village at Mehrgarh
description: Earliest settlement at Mehrgarh is dated to around 7000 BCE, when people practiced early farming (wheat, barley) and domesticated animals (cattle, sheep, goats)
Advanced Bronze Age civilisation flourishes in Crete with elaborate palace complexes

event: 300 BCE - Composition of Early Sangam Literature
description: Earliest known Tamil literature produced during Sangam period, known for its poetry on love, bravery, and social life
The oral composition of early Vedic hymns began around 1500-1200 BCE, with the Rigveda being the earliest collection.

event: 27 BCE - Augustus becomes First Roman Emperor
description: Augustus becomes the first Roman Emperor, marking the beginning of the Roman Empire.

event: 320 CE - Gupta Empire established in India
description: Classical period of Indian civilisation with advances in mathematics, astronomy, and arts

event: 500 CE - Refinement of the complete decimal system with zero
description: Aryabhata uses zero as a positional placeholder, building on earlier Indian mathematical developments during the Gupta period.

event: 1206 CE - Establishment of the Delhi Sultanate
description: Qutb-ud-Din Aibak establishes the Delhi Sultanate
King John of England agrees to a charter limiting royal power and protecting certain rights of nobles.

event: 1440 CE - Invention of the printing press
description: Johannes Gutenberg invents the printing press with movable type in Germany, transforming communication and knowledge sharing.

event: 1498 CE - Vasco da Gama reaches India

event: 1600 CE - Establishment of the British East India Company (India)
description: The British East India Company is formed, beginning a period of British colonial influence in India.

event: 1630 CE - Birth of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj

event: 1885 CE - Formation of Indian National Congress
description: Political platform for Indian leaders to demand reforms from British rule
A series of protests and strikes in Russia lead to the formation of the Duma and reforms, signaling the beginning of Russian unrest.

event: 1914 CE - Start of World War I
description: Global conflict involving major powers begins after the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand

event: 1939 CE - Start of World War II
